beaches.name: Mavra Volia (Mavros Gialos)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established in the farther black-pebble coves beyond the first bay. A naturist directory carries consistent reports from 1998 to 2022; a sign at the first bay forbids nudism and camping there, and that bay is swimwear. Reports call it the one reliable nudist spot on Chios.

beaches.name: Agia Fotia cove
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at a small cove past the rocks left of the main beach. A naturist directory carries August 2022 and 2023 reports of mostly nude visitors there; the main Agia Fotia beach is a local swimwear beach. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Elintas
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix, with nudity mainly from the middle of the beach onwards. A naturist directory carries reports from 2011 to late August 2023; the 2023 report counts over half the weekday visitors nude, while weekends and peak season push nudity to the far end.
